title: Finite product presentation of extended polynomial formal fibres
statement: Let $A$ be a complete Noetherian local domain [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring] whose fraction field has prime characteristic $p$. Let $q\subset A[X]$ be a maximal ideal contracting to the maximal ideal of $A$, and let $0\ne r\subseteq q$ be a prime ideal contracting to zero in $A$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. Let $L/\kappa(r)$ be a finite purely inseparable field extension [def-weil-pbc-g-ring], where residue fields are those of [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Put $C=(A[X]_q)^\wedge$, completed at the maximal ideal [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. There exist $n\ge0$, complete Noetherian local domains $B_i$ for $i\in\operatorname{Fin}(n)$, maximal ideals $q_i\subset B_i[X]$ contracting to the maximal ideals of $B_i$, and nonzero prime ideals $s_i\subseteq q_i$ contracting to zero in $B_i$, such that each canonical $B_i$-algebra $\kappa(s_i)$ is a fraction field of $B_i$ and there is a ring isomorphism $L\otimes_{\kappa(r)}(\kappa(r)\otimes_{A[X]}C)\cong\prod_{i\in\operatorname{Fin}(n)}\left(\kappa(s_i)\otimes_{B_i[X]}(B_i[X]_{q_i})^\wedge\right)$. All $B_i$ have the same universe as $L$. The empty product is the zero ring; no regularity assumption or conclusion occurs in this presentation.

proof.text: Apply exists_finite_coefficient_model to get a finite A-subalgebra B of L, its nonzero evaluation prime s, fraction-field structure and compatible residue-field equivalence.
The subalgebra B of the field L is a domain. Apply the domain clause of finite_over_complete_local_product to obtain that B is Noetherian, local and complete.
Apply completed_fibre_compatible_product with B, s and the compatible equivalence to get the finite family of maximal ideals q_i containing s and the extended fibre isomorphism.
Use constant families B_i=B and s_i=s. Supply all structures and collect the fraction-field and ideal relations with the product isomorphism.
